reviewed_by: Claude: chat Work stage inherits parent stages and reaches Subprojects list
reason: Running goal chats in research subprojects showed no Work stage. chat_work_stage labelled a stage only from the item's own project, but subprojects inherit their nearest ancestor's stages (WorkService.effective_stages, Work page effectiveStages); the join now walks ancestors one level per query. The parent's Subprojects list (GET /chat/projects/{id}/linked-chats) never joined the stage and ChildProjectConversations never rendered it; Core now adds metadata.work_stage there and the row shows WorkStageLabel with the stage in its accessible name. Python selects the global project read tests (new ancestor/shadowing/linked-chats case), chat-session recent page tests and the product-help stage tests plus index digest. Frontend selects ChildProjectConversations (new stage row test) and workStages. Playwright selects area:child-project-chats (real Core on a LAN origin, desktop, compact, Chromium and WebKit 320/390/430) whose fixture now stages one subproject chat from the parent's stages, and conversation-order/model-desktop because its fixture module changed.
exclusions: Butler board and header rendering are unchanged (they already read metadata.work_stage); area:butler-sidebar is not reselected. No native code changed. No full-suite approval.
